method: Whole-file manual reading of four Layout/LayoutPopup files. Pinned source bytes verified; no Windows execution.
findings: CLayout snapshots original outer-window size and control rectangles, applies double move/stretch factors to size differences with integer truncation, and sets minimum tracking size to original size. Factors and resulting child dimensions are not validated here.

Stored dialog RECT is restored directly with MoveWindow and saved with GetWindowRect. This class has no explicit monitor-work-area correction or rescaling of the stored RECT; higher-level correction, if any, is not established by these files.
Gripper width is DPI-scaled once during member initialization. These files have no explicit DPI-change geometry resnapshot; live multi-monitor DPI behavior remains unqualified.
CPositioner batches child positioning through BeginDeferWindowPos/DeferWindowPos/EndDeferWindowPos but has no direct-position fallback on failure. Returned errors are not surfaced.
Popup contains twelve fixed topology/permutation definitions; unknown mapping falls back to index zero. Preview ratios are illustrative and selection delegates actual rebuilding to MainFrame.

Popup chooses nearest monitor and shifts origin against work area. It does not shrink fixed popup dimensions when the work area is smaller than the popup; full visibility is therefore not guaranteed by this positioning code alone.

Popup selection commits options on button release over a card, then rebuilds with resetPositions. Escape, focus loss, app deactivation, capture loss and outside mouse clicks cancel without changing options in those handlers.
Each paint draws all twelve cards and constructs a treemap renderer per visualization preview using a shared static demo tree. No measured paint-cost or caching improvement claim.
limits: No native UI, monitor migration, DPI change, capture, positioning-failure or performance tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred. Global completed repository count remains 147/500.
